'''Red Zone''' was an area within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]] in [[3627 BBY]]. It had a strong presence of [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] and members of [[the Brothers]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] organization.<ref name="Red Zone" />
